id./param/scenario/cs/b_010_cs_040.pack|cs_: "It has been an age since I brought a human here. This is the Guardian Sea, where only the deep's ruler may enter.
"This is the Pearl of Wisdom, a royal treasure. Through any water, from rivers to a drop of dew, it lets one see the surface.
"...I have secretly sent rain to the surface. Through it, you can now see the world.
"Now, {var:1}, are you ready? Touch the Pearl and see how the world fares."
